mapper.sql: EXCHARGE_CODE as exchargeCode, DATASOURCE_TYPE as datasourceType, TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, OPEN_PRICE as openPrice, CLOSE_PRICE as closePrice, MID_PRICE as midPrice, HIGH_PRICE as highPrice, LOW_PRICE as lowPrice, BASIS_CYY as basisCyy, QUOT_UNIT as quotUnit, INPUT_TYPE as inputType, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime
mapper.select:
select
cmei.OPEN_PRICE/(case when cmei.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else cmei.QUOT_UNIT end)
cmei.CLOSE_PRICE/(case when cmei.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else cmei.QUOT_UNIT end)
cmei.HIGH_PRICE/(case when cmei.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else cmei.QUOT_UNIT end)
cmei.LOW_PRICE/(case when cmei.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else cmei.QUOT_UNIT end)
cmei.MID_PRICE/(case when cmei.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else cmei.QUOT_UNIT end)
from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE cmei where cmei.BASIS_CYY= #{ccy} and cmei.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' AND cmei.PUBLISH_DATE= ( select max(TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE where DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and BASIS_CYY = #{ccy} and TRADE_DATE <= #{equityConfDate,jdbcType=DATE})
